card.description: A towering 12‑meter basalt obelisk, carved with Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs, glowing bioluminescent glyphs, a crystalline core pulsing at its heart, intricate copper sensor arrays, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, tactile stone texture, industrial mysticism atmosphere.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Monolithic basalt shaft, 12 m tall, tapering to a pointed apex, etched with lotus and sun‑disk motifs, stone lattice ribs radiating from the center.
**Face/Sensors:** Glowing glyph panels arrayed along the shaft, copper‑plated sensor arrays disguised as hieroglyphs, bioluminescent veins tracing the stone surface.
**Key Features:** Embedded crystalline core, bioluminescent glow, copper wiring, stone lattice ribs, ancient‑tech glyphs.
evolution: Phase 1 (Construction): Raw basalt block, rough carving, no core, glyphs unlit.
Phase 2 (Activation): Core inserted, glyphs illuminated, bioluminescent glow, sensor arrays activated.
props: Item: Crystalline Core – translucent sapphire‑like crystal with embedded circuitry.
Item: Hieroglyphic Sensor Array – copper‑plated panels with etched glyphs.
